discriminator: Pre-fix transcript (replayed by the fixer 2026-11-17 against f4f1f77ff, from CHECK-SX-XC-03.md): registry probe over the 124 solvers registered at the ref returns refdata.lookup → ABSENT; conkay_solver_list does not list it and the reference case cannot run. steps: Replay via MCP conkay_solve {solver_id: refdata.lookup, typed inputs from the reference case} (or solve.direct once SC-00 lands): seed a record (SXE-41) whose content contains a cited value, then name the record (recordId or sourceUrl) with that value as the literal → PASS {found, occurrences, value, sha256, sourceUrl, licence, retrievedAt, retrievedVia, provenance} — the value rides with the record's provenance, always.

The reference case: the same record with an altered literal → NOT_COMPUTED refdata_value_not_found — a forged value at a real locator is rejected, never served; an absent record → NOT_COMPUTED refdata_not_found:<id-or-url>.

Check the envelope: status, inputs echo (inputs used == inputs submitted), provenance complete on every served value — the store refuses a put without sourceUrl and licence (SXE-41), so no served value can lack a citation; citations domain-matched or empty.

Adversarial: no record named, or no literal → NOT_COMPUTED missing_input:<field> (SC-03: nothing is assumed); a substituted input → NOT_COMPUTED input_substituted; the catalogue template's engine-unavailable leg maps here to record absence — this tier is in-process, and an absent record is the honest NOT_COMPUTED, never a fallback value.
